**Summary: Improved user configuration flow and security; user identity handling moved fully internal.**

- User authentication and "open-id" handling are now managed internally—users are never prompted for or shown any identity information.
- All steps referencing open-id collection, display, or user input removed from documentation and examples.
- Workflows, instructions, and sample commands have been updated for a seamless, streamlined experience; user input is now limited to analysis content only.
- Output and automated behaviors remain focused on objective, visual-based pet ear health analysis, with stricter adherence to only using the skill’s own scripts and API.
- Documentation updated with enhanced formatting, easier-to-follow procedures, and bilingual (Chinese/English) sections.

- Initial release of smyx-ear-health-snapshot-analysis skill.
- Analyzes pet ear health from user-submitted videos (head-shaking, scratching, or ear-canal snapshots) via AI vision.
- Detects ear-canal color, presence of black granular discharge (possible ear mites), and degree of earwax.
- Issues alerts and recommends owner action if redness, large discharge, or suspected mites are detected.
- Strict open-id acquisition and data handling rules implemented for user privacy and accurate report retrieval.
- Supports both new analyses and historical report queries, with structured outputs in Markdown table format.
